# Day 16: Remove Duplicates from Sorted Array II

**Date:** 2026-02-04  
**Topic:** Two Pointers  
**Difficulty:** Medium

---

## Notes

At first my approach is wrong ,then  I found out the correct approach.
Spent 1hrs and 30 mins (slow......)

## Solution

```
int removeDuplicates(int* nums, int numsSize) {
   if(numsSize<=2){
    return numsSize;
   }
   else{
    int j=2;
   for(int i=2;i<numsSize;i++){
       if(nums[i]!=nums[j-2]){
           nums[j]=nums[i];
           j++;
       }
   }
   return j;
   }
   
}
```
